RUS_fr_refresh_current_reform = {
	set_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_correction_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_correction_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_correction_easy_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_correction_easy_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor }
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_correction_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_correction_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_correction_easy_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_correction_easy_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor }
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_attack_factor = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_army_armor_attack_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_attack_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_army_armor_attack_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_army_armor_attack_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_attack_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_army_armor_attack_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_correction_army_armor_attack_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_attack_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_correction_army_armor_attack_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_correction_easy_army_armor_attack_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_attack_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_correction_easy_army_armor_attack_factor }
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_defence_factor = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_army_armor_defence_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_defence_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_army_armor_defence_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_army_armor_defence_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_defence_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_army_armor_defence_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_correction_army_armor_defence_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_defence_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_correction_army_armor_defence_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_correction_easy_army_armor_defence_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_defence_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_correction_easy_army_armor_defence_factor }
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_attack_factor = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_army_attack_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_attack_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_army_attack_factor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no has_variable = RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_army_attack_factor }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_attack_factor = var:RUS_fr_result_permanent_easy_army_attack_factor }
	}

			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_terrain_penalty_reduction = 0.02 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_send_volunteer_size = 5 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_experience_from_volunteers = 0.5 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_fr_current_reform_stage = 9 } }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_org_factor = -0.025 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_morale_factor = -0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_experience_gain_army_factor = 0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_experience_gain_factor = -0.1125 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_experience_loss_factor = 0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_mobilization_speed = -0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_land_reinforce_rate = 0.0075 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_training_time_army_factor = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_supply_consumption_factor = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_attrition = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_terrain_penalty_reduction = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_attack_factor = -0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_defence_factor = -0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_breakthrough_factor = -0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_core_attack_factor = -0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_core_defence_factor = -0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_infantry_attack_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_infantry_defence_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_attack_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_defence_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor = -0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor = -0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_land_doctrine_cost_factor = 0.4 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_land_mastery_gain_factor = -0.25 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_special_forces_attack_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_special_forces_defence_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_recruitable_population_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_send_volunteer_size = 5 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_experience_from_volunteers = 0.5 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_experience_gain_army_factor = 0.15 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_land_reinforce_rate = 0.0075 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_terrain_penalty_reduction = 0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_send_volunteer_size = 5 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_experience_from_volunteers = 0.5 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_fr_current_reform_stage = 10 } }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_org_factor = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_morale_factor = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_planning_speed = 0.04 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_max_planning = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_experience_gain_army_factor = 0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_experience_gain_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_experience_loss_factor = 0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_mobilization_speed = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_land_reinforce_rate = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_training_time_army_factor = -0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_supply_consumption_factor = -0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_attrition = -0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_terrain_penalty_reduction = 0.04 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_attack_factor = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_defence_factor = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_breakthrough_factor = 0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_core_attack_factor = -0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_core_defence_factor = -0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_infantry_attack_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_infantry_defence_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_attack_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_armor_defence_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_cold_climate_gain_factor = -0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_acclimatization_hot_climate_gain_factor = -0.2 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_land_doctrine_cost_factor = 0.4 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_land_mastery_gain_factor = -0.25 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_special_forces_attack_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_special_forces_defence_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_recruitable_population_factor = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_send_volunteer_size = 5 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_experience_from_volunteers = 0.5 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_easy_mode_enabled is_ai = no }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_org_factor = 0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_morale_factor = 0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_planning_speed = 0.04 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_max_planning = 0.02 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_experience_gain_army_factor = 0.2 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_mobilization_speed = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_land_reinforce_rate = 0.01 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_training_time_army_factor = -0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_supply_consumption_factor = -0.02 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_attrition = -0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_terrain_penalty_reduction = 0.04 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_attack_factor = 0.02 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_defence_factor = 0.02 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_breakthrough_factor = 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_send_volunteer_size = 5 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_fr_current_army_experience_from_volunteers = 0.5 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = RUS_fr_unified_army_reform_active NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_fr_current_reform_stage > 0 } } } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_fr_current_army_reform } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_fr_current_army_reform }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_fr_unified_army_reform_active } check_variable = { RUS_fr_current_reform_stage > 0 } NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_fr_current_army_reform } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_fr_current_army_reform }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}
